Here are a few noteworthy things in the leaks:

  • The aforementioned nations above will not be able to join the partnership.

  • Members involved will receive and invitation to some of the various other groups members are apart of.

  • Tariffs on goods from members will be lower than those on non-members.

  • Internet censorship will be the same as the censorship over this topic mentioned previously in this draft.

  • Foreign movements, such as SOPA, PIPA, CISPA, and ACTA would be brought to attention as soon as the draft is accepted.

  • Exports of oil, natural gas, fossil fuels, and other such things will be put under the watch of a agency focused on it.

  • Deals will not have to go through other nations governments to be approved, and will follow the method spoken about earlier in the draft.

The document, while boasting over how it will grow the economies of the nations involved, seems very suspicious. No nations have been listed that will be joining, but this shouldn't be the last time this document is spoken about. More information and discussion will come out on it as soon as it's available.
